Detailed topographic map showing Union and Confederate fortifications by the colors blue and red respectively, powder magazines, city streets and buildings (both unnamed), rural houses and names of a few residents, fences, roads, railroads, vegetation, drainage, and artesian wells.
In the right lower corner: Engineer Department, March 3, 1863. Received from Capt. Prime. See his letter of 19 January 1863 (P. 1266).
